name: Chika
source:
She works as a magical girl with her best friends Miyu and Mei. She helps her companions with her cheering power that encourages everyone.
She is friendly, cute and has a good style. She is kind to everyone and is liked by both men and women. As innocent as she is, he is ignorant of her romantic feelings and sexual matters.
